[SWS_Lin_00001]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00407
⌈The function Lin_GetVersionInfo shall return the version information of the LIN mod-
ule. The version information includes:
• Two bytes for the vendor ID
• Two byte for the module ID
• Three bytes version number The numbering shall be vendor specific; it consists
of:
– The major, the minor and the patch version number of the module.
– The AUTOSAR specification version number shall not be included. The AU-
TOSAR specification version number is checked during compile time and
therefore not required in this API.
⌋
